subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should assistant reasoning and tool traces become enabled by default for existing macOS users who have no stored preference?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes an existing visible default, and tests cannot determine whether that upgrade behavior and its screen-privacy implications match product intent.

options.title: Preserve hidden default
options.body: Treat an absent preference as off, retaining prior upgrade behavior while allowing users to enable traces from the new toolbar control.

options.title: Accept default-on traces
options.body: Keep the proposed default but record explicit owner acceptance and provide signed-app proof showing the resulting full-window experience.

recommendation.title: Preserve hidden default
recommendation.body: Treat an absent preference as off, retaining prior upgrade behavior while allowing users to enable traces from the new toolbar control.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the listed project lead and authored the proposed default and surrounding native-chat integration.
